text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Humidity at 40%, indoor atmospheric 
pressure stable. In other words... the 
'perfect environment for muscle 
training.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! That's Bourbon-chan for you, my 
fellow muscle-training buddy! Never 
missing a day of communicating with your 
muscles, even on your day off!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Dialogue...? No. My body fat percentage 
has increased, so I am taking the 
initiative to do some muscle training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see! Strengthening your muscles with fat 
burning as a reward...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Bourbon-chan, got a sec? There's 
somewhere I just have to take you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Our new fat-burning protein! Guaranteed to 
be 10% more effective than before!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It just came out, so only a select few 
Musclers know about it~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...! Thank you for providing such prime 
information.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This is nothing at all. I'm just happy we 
got to have some muscle talk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Why don't we switch up our 
workout spot while we're at it? I know a 
place that'll get us maximum muscular 
attention!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Status: 'Intrigued.' Preparations to 
depart for the muscular spot are complete.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Let's pump each other's muscles up 
to the limit today!

By making good use of the handy tip... 
Mihono Bourbon successfully regained her 
lean physique!
